parsed_entries.requirement: A Certifying Authority's licence may not be suspended or revoked without providing a reasonable opportunity to show cause against the proposed action.
parsed_entries.source: IT Act 2000, Section Regulation of Certifying Authorities
parsed_entries.checkable_test: Check if the licence suspension or revocation process includes a reasonable opportunity for the Certifying Authority to show cause.
parsed_entries.applicability: Applicable to Certifying Authorities under the IT Act 2000.
parsed_entries.notes: This obligation applies to the procedural requirements for licence suspension or revocation.

parsed_entries.requirement: A Certifying Authority whose licence has been suspended may not issue any electronic signature Certificate during the suspension.
parsed_entries.source: IT Act 2000, Section Regulation of Certifying Authorities
parsed_entries.checkable_test: Verify that the Certifying Authority is prohibited from issuing electronic signature certificates during the suspension period.
parsed_entries.applicability: Applicable to Certifying Authorities under the IT Act 2000.
parsed_entries.notes: This is a core obligation regarding the restriction on issuing certificates during licence suspension.

parsed_entries.requirement: The Controller must publish notices of suspension or revocation in all specified repositories.
parsed_entries.source: IT Act 2000, Section Regulation of Certifying Authorities
parsed_entries.checkable_test: Check if the Controller publishes notices of suspension or revocation in all specified repositories.
parsed_entries.applicability: Applicable to Certifying Authorities under the IT Act 2000.
parsed_entries.notes: This obligation ensures transparency in the suspension or revocation process.

parsed_entries.requirement: The Controller may publicise the contents of a database in appropriate electronic or other media.
parsed_entries.source: IT Act 2000, Section Regulation of Certifying Authorities
parsed_entries.checkable_test: Verify if the Controller has the authority to publicise database contents in appropriate media.
parsed_entries.applicability: Applicable to Certifying Authorities under the IT Act 2000.
parsed_entries.notes: This is a procedural obligation regarding the dissemination of database contents.

parsed_entries.requirement: The Controller may delegate powers to officers under this Chapter.
parsed_entries.source: IT Act 2000, Section Regulation of Certifying Authorities
parsed_entries.checkable_test: Check if the Controller has delegated powers to officers for executing functions under this Chapter.
parsed_entries.applicability: Applicable to Certifying Authorities under the IT Act 2000.
parsed_entries.notes: This is a procedural obligation regarding the delegation of authority.

parsed_entries.requirement: The Controller or authorised officer may investigate contraventions of the Act, rules, or regulations.
parsed_entries.source: IT Act 2000, Section Regulation of Certifying Authorities
parsed_entries.checkable_test: Verify if the Controller or authorised officer has the authority to investigate contraventions.
parsed_entries.applicability: Applicable to Certifying Authorities under the IT Act 2000.
parsed_entries.notes: This obligation outlines the investigative powers of the Controller or authorised officers.
